page.title: Discounts
page.subtitle: Run a sale, or share a code and see which channels bring in orders.

empty.title: No discounts yet
empty.hint: A sale lowers your prices for everyone, for as long as you choose. A code is for the people you share it with, and shows you where your buyers came from.
empty.hintReadOnly: Owners and editors can create discounts here.

performance.title: How your discounts are doing
performance.channelsDescription: Codes count under the channel you shared them on, or under the code itself when you didn't name one.
performance.channelsEmpty: No orders with a discount yet.

list.title: Your discounts
list.orders: {orders, plural, =0 {No orders yet} one {# order} other {# orders}}

copy.failed: Couldn't copy the code. Select and copy it manually.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this discount?
confirmDelete.body: It stops applying straight away. Orders it already brought in stay counted.

confirmEnd.title: End this sale now?
confirmEnd.body: Prices go back to normal straight away. To run it again later, create a new sale.

kind.title: What kind of discount?
kind.codeHint: Buyers type it at checkout, and you see which channel brought them.
kind.automaticHint: Lowers your prices for everyone. No code needed.

code.title: Code
code.label: Code
code.hint: 3 to 24 letters or numbers. Buyers can type it in capitals or not.

value.title: How much off?
value.each: Taken off the price of each item.
value.order: Taken off the order's items. Delivery is not discounted.
value.currencyHint: Applies only to products priced in this currency.

products.title: Which products?
products.summary: {count, plural, =0 {Choose products} one {# product chosen} other {# products chosen}}

schedule.title: When?
schedule.timeZone: Times are in your time zone ({zone}).

form.locked: This sale has started, so only its end can change. To change anything else, end it and create a new sale.

summary.title: Summary
summary.chipLink: Change how sales look on your storefront
